verdict.rationale: LobeHub's own docs state that each agent has persistent memory that the user can edit and that 'co-evolves' with humans, which directly matches durable cross-session memory. There is only one brief marketing-level mention, and it never documents how memory is written or recalled automatically. Missing for 10: documentation of automatic memory writing and automatic recall in conversations, detail on memory scope (per-user vs per-agent) and management, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an everyday user, the assistant remembers me across sessions — durable long-term memory it can write to and recall from automatically

citations.quote: Each agent has persistent memory, editable by you, allowing humans and agents to co-evolve over time.
